video_title: Jaylen Brown Made Fifty Million Last Year And Keeps Almost None In The Bank

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on his path to becoming an NBA millionaire
quotes.excerpt: I dropped out of college and pursued my dream. I became an NBA player.

text_blocks.speaker: Host
text_blocks.text: How old were you when you became a millionaire?

text_blocks.speaker: Jaylen Brown
text_blocks.text: How old was I? 18. I dropped out of college and pursued my dream. I became an NBA player.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on using adversity and failure as motivation
quotes.excerpt: The more I failed, those have been the blessings in my life.

text_blocks.speaker: Host
text_blocks.text: What was the biggest driving factor of your success that enabled you to work your way up and become a professional basketball player at the highest of the industry?

text_blocks.speaker: Jaylen Brown
text_blocks.text: Adversity and failure. I think people have a negative perception to adversity and failure. Actually, seek it. The more I failed, those have been the blessings in my life. The more of that adversity, it unlocks work ethic, it unlocks discipline, and it unlocks creativity. So, fail more.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on why he doesn't keep money in the bank
quotes.excerpt: The richest people never do. They understand that money is just paper.

text_blocks.speaker: Host
text_blocks.text: Do you keep a lot of money in the bank?

text_blocks.speaker: Jaylen Brown
text_blocks.text: No. And the richest people never do. They understand that money is just paper. I think that what people value the most is subjective, but a lot of the richest people, social capital is what they're after.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on his approach to business negotiations
quotes.excerpt: I will run away from it. I'm okay. I'm not very materialistic. I'm grateful.

text_blocks.speaker: Host
text_blocks.text: Are you a good negotiator? Are you not afraid to walk away from a deal if it doesn't align?

text_blocks.speaker: Jaylen Brown
text_blocks.text: I'm a great negotiator. I will run away from it. I'm okay. I'm not very materialistic. I'm grateful.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on dealing with hate and criticism
quotes.excerpt: They don't build statues for haters. They build statues for people that do things.

text_blocks.speaker: Host
text_blocks.text: The most successful people in the world, they inevitably deal with a lot of hate. How do you feel about haters?

text_blocks.speaker: Jaylen Brown
text_blocks.text: It's a part of it. When you have haters, that means you're doing something right. I don't let it discourage me. I don't let it stop me. They don't build statues for haters. They build statues for people that do things.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on the difference between imitators and originators
quotes.excerpt: The moon may steal light from the sun, but the sun is still the sun.

text_blocks.speaker: Host
text_blocks.text: If me and you died tomorrow and you had one more guiding principle to leave with the younger generation, what would that be?

text_blocks.speaker: Jaylen Brown
text_blocks.text: The moon steals light from the sun, but people never get the two confused. People will imitate you, take your style, imitate your brand, or take your lingo, everything that you do. But the moon may steal light from the sun, but the sun is still the sun, it still shines every day. We don't get the two confused.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on overcoming mental health struggles
quotes.excerpt: I've dealt with anxiety, even depression. I've been to some very dark places, to be honest, mentally.

text_blocks.speaker: Host
text_blocks.text: Did you ever doubt yourself? How did you overcome that? Talk to somebody at rock bottom right now.

text_blocks.speaker: Jaylen Brown
text_blocks.text: I have, many of times. I've dealt with anxiety, even depression. I've been to some very dark places, to be honest, mentally, but I feel like those dark places have allowed my light to shine. I would say it's okay. It's all right. I know what you're feeling and experiencing. I know that feeling of what you're going through, the doubt, the fear, the lack of trust that you may have in yourself, but just remind yourself that you can do great things, that you can, and you will.
